rules.title: Language is metadata, never a gate
rules.text: N10/N11: support is unconditional and no language or filetype may gate attachment, sync or the verb set; classification is metadata, never a filter (PROTOCOL.md §1).

judgement.question: Does this gate attachment, sync, the verb set or an action on a language or filetype — rather than carry, resolve or merely document one as metadata?

criteria.true: the language or filetype decides whether a document is attached or synced, which verbs or actions are offered, or whether something is skipped
criteria.false: the language or filetype is carried as metadata, resolved as a hint, aliased, logged, or named in a comment without changing what is offered
